title: Bound the Benefits Package Registry against scheme operations
requirements:
- Distinguish the Benefits Package Registry and other registries from enrolment, contracting, claims and payment systems
- Define the BPR as the authoritative publication of benefit definitions, not an eligibility or adjudication engine
- Limit the registry to authoritative benefit definitions and machine-readable rules
- Require CBMS implementations to reconcile enrolment against the shared Client Registry identity
- Separate workforce credential checks from contracting, empanelment and claim validity
- Separate payment rails from decisions about correctness and authorisation; use measured language about fraud prevention
- Keep enrolment, empanelment and contracting in operational systems that reference registries
- State that enrolment, eligibility determination, contracting and adjudication sit in operational systems
